parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
attribute[ætribju:t]n.
An attribute is a characteristic of a person or thing.
→ He isn’t very clever, but he does have some other positive attributes.
😎
bilingual[bailiŋgwəl]adj.
If someone is bilingual, then they can speak two languages.
→ Since you already know English, after learning French you’ll be bilingual.
😎
clone[kloun]n.
A clone is an identical copy of a living creature.
→ Scientists recently made a clone of a sheep.
😎
colloquial[kəloukwiəl]adj.
Colloquial describes informal words that are more suitable for speech than writing.
→ I find it difficult to understand people if they use colloquial language.
😎
cosmetics[kɑzmetiks]n.
Cosmetics are substances that make the face and skin more beautiful.
→ Girls often look nicer when they don’t use so many cosmetics.
😎
dash[dæʃ]v.
To dash means to run or move quickly.
→ Helen dashed up the stairs, so she wouldn’t be late for her appointment.
😎
disgust[disgʌst]n.
Disgust is a feeling of distaste and anger caused by something rude or unpleasant.
→ He felt disgust toward his date because she had such terrible eating habits.
😎
fluorescent[fluəresnt]adj.
If something is fluorescent, it is such a bright color that it seems to give off light.
→ She highlighted the key words in the document with a fluorescent yellow pen.
😎
furious[fjuəriəs]adj.
If you are furious, you are extremely angry.
→ My father was furious when he read my bad school report.
😎
astounded[əstaundid]adj.
If you are astounded, you are very surprised.
→ I was astounded that Monica won the art competition.
😎
gulf[gʌlf]n.
A gulf is a gap between people who do not understand each other.
→ There has been a gulf between James and Tony since their parents died.
😎
humanities[hju:mænətiz]n.
Humanities are subjects which analyze human ideas, such as history and literature.
→ Jennifer has always been more interested in humanities than science.
😎
knot[nɑt]n.
A knot is made when you tie the ends of rope or cord together.
→ He tied a knot in his shoelaces, so they wouldn’t come off during the race.
😎
linguist[liŋgwist]n.
A linguist is someone who studies languages.
→ Tony is a good linguist and speaks four different languages.
😎
participant[pɑ:rtisəpənt]n.
A participant is someone who joins in a social event or competition.
→ There were thousands of participants in this year’s marathon.
😎
plausible[plɔ:zəbəl]adj.
If something is plausible, it is reasonable or possible.
→ It is plausible that Jack isn’t here today because he is sick.
😎
ritual[ritʃuəl]n.
A ritual is a formal custom that people do regularly.
→ Ken was very interested to learn about the religious rituals of the natives.
😎
sibling[sibliŋ]n.
A sibling is a brother or sister.
→ Jane has two siblings, an older brother and a younger sister.
😎
skinny[skini]adj.
If someone is skinny, they are extremely thin.
→ Polly is very skinny. I think she needs to eat more.
😎
vague[veig]adj.
If something is vague, it is not clear, and it gives very few details.
→ I asked him about his mother’s health, but he was very vague about it.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: Cosmetics are typically used to make someone______ .
questions.explanation: Cosmetics (Mỹ phẩm) thường được dùng để làm cho ai đó trông đẹp hơn (look better).

questions.content: Which of the following would NOT be considered a subject studied in humanities?
questions.explanation: Toán học (Mathematics) là môn khoa học tự nhiên, không phải là môn khoa học nhân văn (humanities).

questions.content: Which of the following could NOT be used to make a knot?
questions.explanation: Những đám mây (Lines of clouds) không thể dùng để thắt nút (knot), trong khi dây kẽm, chỉ và len thì có thể.

questions.content: Positive attributes include being energetic, optimistic, and___
questions.explanation: Các thuộc tính (attributes) tích cực bao gồm năng động, lạc quan và vui vẻ (cheerful).

questions.content: Which of the following is similar in meaning to the word dash?
questions.explanation: Dash có nghĩa là chạy hoặc di chuyển nhanh chóng, đồng nghĩa với từ Run (hoặc Sprint, nhưng đáp án theo sách là Run).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the one that is similar in meaning to the given word.

questions.content: astounded
questions.explanation: Astounded có nghĩa là kinh ngạc, rất ngạc nhiên (surprised).

questions.content: disgust
questions.explanation: Disgust là cảm giác ghê tởm hoặc tức giận, gần nghĩa với anger (tức giận).

questions.content: gulf
questions.explanation: Gulf (khoảng cách, sự khác biệt) đồng nghĩa với từ gap (khoảng trống, khoảng cách).

questions.content: vague
questions.explanation: Vague có nghĩa là mơ hồ, không rõ ràng (unclear).

questions.content: furious
questions.explanation: Furious có nghĩa là cực kỳ tức giận (angry).

questions.content: bilingual
questions.explanation: Bilingual là người có thể nói hoặc sử dụng hai ngôn ngữ (using two languages).

questions.content: clone
questions.explanation: Clone là bản sao hoàn hảo, đồng nghĩa với copy.

questions.content: plausible
questions.explanation: Plausible có nghĩa là hợp lý hoặc có thể xảy ra (possible).

questions.content: skinny
questions.explanation: Skinny có nghĩa là cực kỳ gầy gò (thin).

questions.content: fluorescent
questions.explanation: Fluorescent có nghĩa là phát sáng hoặc rất sáng (bright).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: Kevin was very vague about his job interview, and he told me all the details.
questions.explanation: Vague có nghĩa là mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. Nếu anh ta kể chi tiết (told me all the details) thì không thể dùng vague ở đây. Sai (I).

questions.content: Liam had a plausible reason for not doing his work, saying aliens took it.
questions.explanation: Plausible là hợp lý. Việc nói người ngoài hành tinh lấy cắp bài tập thì không phải là lý do hợp lý. Sai (I).

questions.content: Tom can only speak English. He is bilingual.
questions.explanation: Bilingual là người nói 2 ngôn ngữ. Tom chỉ nói được mỗi tiếng Anh thì không phải là bilingual. Sai (I).

questions.content: Emma likes studying humanities like chemistry and physics.
questions.explanation: Hóa học và vật lý là khoa học tự nhiên, không phải là khoa học nhân văn (humanities). Sai (I).

questions.content: Ivy doesn’t have any siblings. It must be lonely without brothers or sisters.
questions.explanation: Siblings nghĩa là anh chị em ruột. Câu này dùng đúng từ (C).

questions.content: The two brothers looked so much alike that they could be clones.
questions.explanation: Clones là bản sao y hệt. Hai anh em nhìn quá giống nhau như những bản sao. Câu này dùng đúng từ (C).

questions.content: My mother was furious when she heard that I passed all my exams.
questions.explanation: Furious là cực kỳ tức giận. Mẹ không thể tức giận khi nghe tin con qua tất cả các kỳ thi được. Sai (I).

questions.content: Miranda is so skinny. She really needs to lose some weight.
questions.explanation: Skinny là quá gầy. Nếu cô ấy đã gầy thì không cần thiết phải giảm cân (lose some weight). Sai (I).

questions.content: I was filled with disgust when I heard the news that he had lied to all of us.
questions.explanation: Disgust là sự ghê tởm, tức giận. Tôi cảm thấy ghê tởm khi biết anh ta đã nói dối. Câu này dùng đúng từ (C).

questions.content: Sarah and I really understand each other. There is a big gulf between us.
questions.explanation: Gulf là khoảng cách, sự khác biệt. Nếu thực sự thấu hiểu nhau thì không thể có một khoảng cách lớn giữa hai người. Sai (I).

questions.content: Around the world, there are lots of different marriage rituals.
questions.explanation: Rituals là các nghi thức. Câu nói có nhiều nghi thức kết hôn khác nhau là sử dụng đúng (C).

questions.content: We had lots of participants in the fishing competition last Saturday.
questions.explanation: Participants là người tham gia. Chúng tôi có rất nhiều người tham gia cuộc thi câu cá. Sử dụng đúng (C).

questions.content: Kay is a linguist and will give a lecture on the best way to learn a language.
questions.explanation: Linguist là nhà ngôn ngữ học. Việc Kay là nhà ngôn ngữ học và thuyết trình về cách học ngôn ngữ là đúng ngữ cảnh (C).

questions.content: You should wear dark clothes for the interview, such as your fluorescent jacket.
questions.explanation: Fluorescent là màu sắc rực rỡ, phát sáng. Nó không phải là quần áo tối màu (dark clothes). Sai (I).

questions.content: You always dash so slowly. I wish you would walk faster.
questions.explanation: Dash nghĩa là chạy nhanh, lao đi nhanh. Không thể kết hợp với "so slowly" (rất chậm). Sai (I).

questions.content: I can’t use this thread for sewing because it has too many knots in it.
questions.explanation: Knots là những nút thắt. Sợi chỉ có quá nhiều nút thắt thì không thể dùng khâu vá được. Câu này đúng (C).

questions.content: Jan wanted to make a cake, so she went to the shop to buy some cosmetics.
questions.explanation: Cosmetics là mỹ phẩm. Bạn không thể làm bánh bằng mỹ phẩm được. Sai (I).

questions.content: The lesson was long and boring, and all the students felt astounded.
questions.explanation: Astounded là kinh ngạc. Bài học dài và chán thì học sinh phải thấy chán nản, chứ không thể thấy kinh ngạc. Sai (I).

questions.content: I think Tom should get the job because he has all the right attributes.
questions.explanation: Attributes là những đặc điểm, phẩm chất. Tom nên có công việc vì anh ta có những phẩm chất phù hợp. Đúng (C).

questions.content: You shouldn’t use colloquial language when you make formal presentations.
questions.explanation: Colloquial language là ngôn ngữ giao tiếp đời thường. Bạn không nên dùng nó trong các buổi thuyết trình trang trọng. Đúng (C).

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Twins

Katie and Alice were twins. They were so alike that few people could tell the siblings apart. They were almost like clones. They even used the same colloquial language as each other. They were best friends.

But the twins’ attributes were not all identical. Alice liked humanities, and Katie was a good linguist. One summer, Katie decided to be a participant at a summer camp in France. Alice wasn’t interested in the French language, so she didn’t go. But she felt angry that Katie wanted to spend the summer away from her.

Two months later, Katie returned. Alice dashed to the airport to greet her sister. But when Alice saw Katie, she was astounded. Katie was now bilingual, and she looked completely different! She was wearing nice clothes, cosmetics and looked skinnier. Alice felt very messy next to her. She was just wearing a fluorescent t-shirt, and her hair had knots in it.

When Alice asked Katie about France, Katie was vague and didn’t say much. It made Alice furious and filled her with disgust because in the past they’d always told each other everything. Now there was a huge gulf between them. Over the weeks, the sisters spoke even less.

Two months later, it was the twins’ birthday. All their lives, they’d had a ritual. Before their birthday, they’d talk all night long. That night, Alice came into Katie’s bedroom.

“I’m sorry I haven’t spoken much lately,” Katie said.

“I understand. You have new friends now,” said Alice, angrily.

Katie said, “My French friends don’t write much nowadays. For a while, I thought they were more exciting than my friends at home. But I was wrong. You’re my sister, and you’ll always be my best friend.”

Alice said, “I’m sorry, too. I wanted our relationship to stay the same forever. But it’s totally plausible for twins to have different interests. We can still be best friends without being together all the time.”

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: The girls looked like clones, but they used different colloquial language.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 1, tác giả viết "They were almost like clones. They even used the same colloquial language as each other." (Họ gần như là những bản sao. Họ thậm chí còn sử dụng chung một loại ngôn ngữ thông tục). Vì vậy, họ dùng chung một ngôn ngữ chứ không phải khác nhau (different).

questions.content: The twins’ attributes were different in that Katie was bilingual and Alice liked humanities.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn 2, bài đọc chỉ ra sự khác biệt "Alice liked humanities, and Katie was a good linguist." (Alice thích khoa học xã hội, còn Katie là một nhà ngôn ngữ học giỏi). Ban đầu Katie là một nhà ngôn ngữ học (linguist), sau khi trở về cô mới trở thành người thạo hai thứ tiếng (bilingual). Câu hỏi gộp chung đặc điểm ban đầu là không chính xác.

questions.content: Alice’s hair was in knots when she dashed to the airport to meet her sister.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3, khi đón Katie tại sân bay, bài miêu tả Alice "She was just wearing a fluorescent t-shirt, and her hair had knots in it." (Cô ấy chỉ mặc một chiếc áo phông dạ quang và tóc thì bù xù). Thông tin này là đúng.

questions.content: Alice was astounded when she saw Katie wearing a fluorescent t-shirt.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3 cho biết "Katie was now bilingual, and she looked completely different! She was wearing nice clothes, cosmetics and looked skinnier." (Katie giờ đã thông thạo hai thứ tiếng và cô ấy trông hoàn toàn khác! Cô ấy mặc quần áo đẹp, trang điểm và trông gầy hơn). Người mặc áo dạ quang (fluorescent t-shirt) là Alice, không phải Katie.

questions.content: When the gulf formed between the sisters, they stopped speaking to each other in detail.
questions.explanation: Ở cuối đoạn 4, bài có nói "Now there was a huge gulf between them. Over the weeks, the sisters spoke even less." (Giờ đây có một khoảng cách lớn giữa họ. Qua nhiều tuần, hai chị em thậm chí còn ít nói chuyện với nhau hơn). Điều này hoàn toàn khớp.

questions.content: Why didn’t Alice want to be a participant at the summer camps with the other linguists?
options: Alice didn't have money for the trip.
Alice had to study for exams.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 giải thích rõ "Alice wasn't interested in the French language, so she didn't go." (Alice không hứng thú với tiếng Pháp nên cô ấy không đi).

questions.content: How did Alice feel when she saw Katie looking skinny and wearing cosmetics?
options: Alice felt very proud of her.
Alice felt very messy next to her.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 3 ghi rõ cảm xúc của Alice "Alice felt very messy next to her." (Alice cảm thấy mình rất luộm thuộm khi đứng cạnh cô ấy).

questions.content: Why was Alice furious and filled with disgust when Katie answered her questions in a vague way?
options: Because in the past they’d always told each other everything.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4 viết "It made Alice furious and filled her with disgust because in the past they'd always told each other everything." (Điều đó khiến Alice tức giận và tràn ngập sự ghê tởm vì trước đây họ luôn kể cho nhau nghe mọi chuyện).

questions.content: What ritual did the siblings always do before their birthday?
options: They would bake a cake together.
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 5, bài viết "All their lives, they'd had a ritual. Before their birthday, they'd talk all night long." (Trong suốt cuộc đời mình, họ có một thói quen. Trước ngày sinh nhật, họ sẽ nói chuyện thâu đêm).

questions.content: What did Alice learn was plausible?
options: It’s plausible for twins to hate each other.
It's totally plausible to be bilingual.
It’s totally plausible for twins to have different interests.
It's plausible to learn French in a month.
questions.explanation: Ở đoạn cuối, Alice nói "But it's totally plausible for twins to have different interests." (Nhưng hoàn toàn hợp lý khi các cặp song sinh có những sở thích khác nhau).
